conclusion.interpretation: All three conditions passed both development cases. The sample does not demonstrate benefit from skill presence or revision. It also does not establish general equivalence or absence of benefit.
conclusion.exploratory: Revised actors executed four protocol/mode controls each; other runs executed one to three. This breadth was not a predeclared scoring dimension and is not counted as an improvement.
limits: Two development cases, selected from one changed skill, one fresh actor per condition/case; no unseen holdout or repeated trials.
Same inherited model/reasoning settings, exact runtime model identifier unavailable; no token/cost or statistical variance measurement.
Full packages supplied in skill conditions; actual reference use differs (revised actors read the existing validation-cases reference, baseline actors did not).
Procedural isolation only; access inventories are actor reports and are not a complete independently enforced read audit.
Local Node TCP models, not actual Envoy, MySQL, TLS, Kubernetes, production traffic or latency benchmarks.
The 30 criterion judgments are nested within six actor runs on two cases, not 30 independent evaluations.
Activation/discovery, all other skills and catalog-wide quality are not evaluated by this comparison.
